preconditions: Independent Primary4 subject/rubric/inclusion review and teacher permission before delivery.
An adult plays a fictional peer; use only a harmless turn-taking game and the bounded supplied line. Never ask a pupil to manipulate another pupil or actually exclude anyone.
No physical contact, name-calling, threats, real misconduct, personal experiences or disclosures. Respect a stop option and accessible equivalent communication.
evidenceRequirements: Record the individual learner’s actual invitation, bounded pretend line and out-of-role explanation against the criteria.
Written plans alone do not demonstrate the role; do not award credit for genuine coercion or exclusion.
